items.tldr: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5 — API price drops 90%, competing with GPT-6 Luna
items.tldr_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，API 价格降 90%，对标 GPT-6 Luna
items.take: When intelligence is nearly free, what becomes truly scarce?
items.take_zh: 当智能便宜到接近免费，真正稀缺的变成了什么？

items.tldr: AI labs ship new models at breakneck pace — 'model fatigue' sets in
items.tldr_zh: AI 实验室以极快节奏发布新模型，「模型疲劳」开始出现
items.take: Are users tired of the models, or of the anxiety of having to keep up?
items.take_zh: 用户疲劳的是模型，还是「必须跟上」的焦虑？

items.tldr: OpenAI publishes new math proof; same day, a super PAC targets 'AI-backed' candidates
items.tldr_zh: OpenAI 发布新数学证明，同日超级 PAC 针对「受 AI 支持」的候选人
items.take: AI proves truths while humans prove positions — which is harder to automate?
items.take_zh: AI 在证明真理的同时，人类在忙着证明立场——哪边更难自动化？
